verdict.rationale: An IP office's online filing and search portal could plausibly offer a built-in AI assistant, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions an AI assistant, chatbot, or agent that takes delegated tasks. The only assistance documented is human INPI experts answering questions, which is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
